name: Podcasts
description: Manage podcast subscriptions with automatic RSS feed updates, episode downloads, auto-delete after listening, and daily auto-playlist generation.
overview: Subscribe to podcast RSS feeds, automatically download new episodes, manage auto-deletion of listened content, and generate a daily auto-playlist of unlistened episodes.
changelog:
- Fixed: Playlist image and RunningTime now update correctly on every generation (delete+recreate with confirmed deletion)
- Fixed: No more duplicate playlists (Podcasts1, Podcasts11...) - polls DB until old playlist is confirmed deleted
- Fixed: Duplicates cleaned up BEFORE main deletion to free all variant names
- Fixed: Pinned Jellyfin packages to 10.11.11 for compatibility with latest stable
- Fixed: Compatibility with Jellyfin 10.11.9+ (IUserManager.GetUsers())
- Fixed: Auto-delete uses LastPlayedDate fallback for external clients
- Fixed: Feed frequency respected by scheduled task (Weekly=Mondays, Monthly=1st)
